published_ranges._ams: Compatible, but wears Teflon and inline plastic parts (TDS)
published_ranges._notes: Carbon black/carbon fiber composite, ESD-safe (TDS: typically 1e4-1e7 ohm surface resistance). PEI or similar with Magigoo or glue stick for release. Extra purge needed. Density from SDS.

conflicts: Material Data Table (https://proto-pasta.com/pages/material-data-table) lists 220C @ 6 mm3/s, 240C @ 12 mm3/s, 55C plate
